theory.heading: What Edge Deployment of AI is
theory.body: Edge Deployment of AI describes the methods and patterns used within AI Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Edge Deployment of AI matters
theory.body: Without Edge Deployment of AI, systems built with AI Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Edge Deployment of AI works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Edge Deployment of AI follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Edge Deployment of AI
theory.body: Edge Deployment of AI offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
